title: in repos/activity-api/src/services/trace-retention.ts, the rollupReachHistory function folds reach counts into reach_his
description:
in repos/activity-api/src/services/trace-retention.ts, the rollupReachHistory function folds reach counts into reach_history with an additive UPSERT. The exact lines are:

           reached = (reached ?? 0) + $reached,
           total = (total ?? 0) + $total,

Because the bucket UPSERT is additive and the watermark UPSERT is a separate statement issued afterwards, any run whose bucket writes succeed while the watermark write fails or lags re-adds the same rows on the next run, inflating the weekly totals monotonically. Live evidence: week 2026-08-17 reports total=414944, which is 24x more execution rows than have ever existed in the retained store (17393). Make the weekly fold idempotent so re-scanning a row range cannot double-count.
